changes.title: Legend share
items: Sleeping legends are rarer: about one area in five has one, not one in two

changes.title: Legends loom
items: Sleeping legends lie on the ground instead of half sunk into it
A legend's dream bubble and its circle's notes keep clear of the legend itself
In a legend's circle the camera comes down lower and a little closer, so the legend looms over you

changes.title: Flask in stack
items: The flask sigil now sits in your sigil stack and cycles with it; when it's at the bottom, E puts it down (by a sleeping legend, in its circle, it wakes it happy; anywhere else it lies on the ground for you to pick up again)
